name: Skrepljonnye krov'ju
source: Hi! How are you doing? I hope you're not passing by... You know, I'm all alone. They left me. And now I'm lying in the toilet. It's so nice, I don't even want to leave. But the blood coming out of the rusty tap is getting a bit annoying. Would you like to keep me company? There's not much time left.
translation: 你好！你好吗？我希望你没有路过……你知道，我孤身一人。他们离开了我。现在我正躺在厕所里。真是太好了，我什至不想离开。但从生锈的水龙头里流出来的血有点烦人。你愿意陪我吗？剩下的时间不多了。
